faithful_view.capacity_assignment: single GPU with 512 active sequence cap, 512 max batch tokens, 8,000,000 KV tokens
faithful_view.conversation_session_structure: not available for Azure 2023; BurstGPT session_id may exist in corpus but PolicySeparationScenario requests do not expose it
faithful_view.generated_output_tokens: native output_tokens, fill missing with 1 and clip lower bound at 1
faithful_view.interarrival_timing: preserved within window after rebasing first arrival to t=0
faithful_view.predicted_output_tokens: set equal to actual_output_tokens; inert for full_prefill/chunked_prefill, visible to ESTF/KV when Phase A evaluates full P6
faithful_view.prompt_input_tokens: native prompt_tokens, fill missing with 1 and clip lower bound at 1
faithful_view.request_ordering: preserved within each selected source window after source-level chronological normalization
faithful_view.service_rate_assumptions: step_size=0.001, prefill modeling enabled, prefill_cost_per_token=1.0, step_token_budget=512, decode/prefill contention enabled, decode_first=False
faithful_view.slo_deadline: arrival + 1000.0 in faithful view; inert for faithful-view policies, visible to LLF if full P6 is queried
faithful_view.time_shift: each window is rebased so first arrival is 0.0
